dependency.foundationBody: Transmission, history and review read macro snapshots, observations and policy events, and those are not wired yet. The page does not assemble charts from empty data.
dependency.judgmentsUnavailableBody: The F4 judgment service cannot be reached, or there is no usable judgment card. Facts are shown as usual and no playbook is marked.

flow.title: Live transmission flow
flow.legend: Badges name each node's source; arrows are untested mechanism assumptions
flow.formulaNote: Both inputs must be observations of the same period and are subtracted as exact decimals; different periods are never subtracted.

playbook.title: Playbooks
playbook.subtitle: Static hypothesis framework, not a call
playbook.supportNote: Rule support is a rule-table parameter and is never shown as a percentage
playbook.offNote: Judgment layer off: no playbook is marked and no rule hits are shown.
playbook.earlier: The F4 call refers to an earlier snapshot ({date}); nothing is marked here.

f4.title: F4 judgment summary
f4.noNumbers: This page shows no F4 distribution, margin or historical hit numbers.

matrix.title: Fed policy → US and China asset response
matrix.subtitle: Event windows · descriptive statistics
matrix.footer: Median and quartiles (type-7); n counts independent complete events; base = month end before the effective month, end = the Nth month end counting the effective month; overlapping windows keep the earlier event; past event windows are not a forecast.

exclusion.overlap: Window overlaps an earlier selected event

history.title: Fed policy action episodes × asset interval changes
history.subtitle: Retrospective fact table · descriptive statistics

boundaryDef.event_day: From = the last daily observation before the episode's first effective date; to = the last daily observation on or before its last effective date.
boundaryDef.first_trading_day: From = the first daily observation on or after the first effective date; to = the first daily observation on or after the last effective date.
boundaryDef.month_end: From = the month-end observation of the month before the first effective date; to = the month-end observation of the last effective date's month, missing while that month is open.

history.coverageNote: An observation more than 7 calendar days from its boundary date, or not in the required month, counts as missing.

flag.leftCensored: Left-censored: the start may predate the data
flag.ongoing: Ongoing: the end is the last event's effective date
flag.gapAfter: Data gap: the transition event cannot be verified

history.mediansNote: Each column on its own scale, for shape only
history.footer: Availability is the first-seen collection time (first_seen); this is a retrospective fact table, not what was knowable at the time
history.eventsTruncated: The policy event history read was truncated: episodes cannot be listed (this is not an empty history)

review.title: Monthly review
review.indexSubtitle: Region × month · built on the 3rd at 06:00 UTC for the previous month
review.scope: Month end versus month end, not a daily activity ledger; the cutoff is the 3rd of the next month, 00:00 UTC.
review.insufficient: No non-failed snapshot existed at this month's cutoff; only the reason is recorded.
review.baselineMissing: No snapshot at the baseline cutoff (the 3rd of this month, 00:00 UTC); this section is empty
review.revisionScope: Covers only each series' latest period in the snapshot; earlier revisions are outside v1.
review.footer: Method {method} · manifest {manifest} · input hash {hash} · code version {code} · generation {generation}

explain.title: Explanation
explain.loadingList: Looking up earlier explanations for this subject; generation stays off until the lookup finishes.
explain.readError: Earlier explanations could not be read ({code}); generation is off so a running or stored explanation is not duplicated.
explain.pendingNote: The outcome of the last request is unknown. Retrying reuses the same request, so a stored result is recovered without a second model call.
explain.header: Bound to {subject} · manifest {manifest} · model {model} · prompt {prompt} · validator {validator}
explain.disclaimer: Fact sentences are generated by the system from frozen data; mechanism hypotheses are written by the model and are unverified.
explain.intro: The system's fact sentences come first, then the model's mechanism hypotheses; model text containing numbers or forbidden terms is never shown.
explain.runningBody: The model is writing; deterministic validation follows.
explain.runningStale: A request still running after {minutes} minutes is marked failed when you refresh; you can then generate again.
explain.rejectedBody: Model text is not shown. Validation failures:
explain.failedBody: The model call failed and produced no text to validate. A new request can retry.
explain.conflict: This request id was already used for different content ({code})
explain.noFacts: This subject has no facts to explain
explain.noSubject: The snapshot or review to explain was not found

failure.unknown_fact: Cites a fact that does not exist
failure.validator_version_changed: Validator updated; the stored output was not re-judged
failure.daily_cost_exhausted: Today's platform cost budget is used up

deviation.title: Deviation cases
deviation.subtitle: Inputs at registration versus inputs recomputed at settlement

evidence.evidence_incomplete: Evidence incomplete: the settlement evidence lacks recomputed inputs
